# Pooler

> Pooler is a local proxy that connects AI coding tools (Cursor, Devin, Factory Droid, Claude Code, and AI SDKs) to AI subscriptions (ChatGPT / Codex) and model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok). It translates request formats, pools multiple accounts to bypass rate limits, stores credentials in encrypted SQLite, and provides a local web dashboard for monitoring requests.

Pooler is configured using YAML with safe secret references (`env:`, `file:`, `keyring:`) and provides built-in presets for coding agents.

## Agent Prompts (Task Recipes)

Give these prompts to any AI coding agent to automate setup and configuration:

- [Agent Native Prompts Cookbook](docs/agent-native.md): Ready-to-use task recipes for coding agents.
- [Bootstrap Starter](docs/agent-native.md#bootstrap-starter-deployment): "Initialize a new secure Pooler deployment in ./pooler-starter, generate secrets, and verify configuration."
- [Connect Codex Subscription](docs/agent-native.md#connect-chatgpt--codex-subscription-via-device-flow): "Authenticate an OpenAI / ChatGPT / Codex subscription via device code flow and verify encrypted storage."
- [Import Local Codex Credentials](docs/agent-native.md#import-local-codex-cli-credentials): "Import local Codex CLI credentials from ~/.codex/credentials.json into Pooler's encrypted store."
- [Connect Google Gemini](docs/agent-native.md#connect-google-gemini-via-browser-pkce-oauth): "Authenticate Google Gemini via browser PKCE OAuth and verify account status."
- [Configure Multi-Account Failover](docs/agent-native.md#pool-multiple-codex-subscriptions--api-keys-with-automatic-failover): "Configure account pooling across multiple subscriptions and API keys with automatic rate-limit failover."
- [Configure Cursor Adapter](docs/agent-native.md#configure-cursor-ide-adapter): "Configure Pooler with the Cursor preset on port 8333 with gpt- prefix routing and high reasoning effort."
- [Configure Devin ConnectRPC](docs/agent-native.md#configure-devin-connectrpc-bridge): "Configure Pooler for Devin ConnectRPC translation on port 18473 translating to OpenAI upstream."
- [Configure Factory Droid](docs/agent-native.md#configure-factory-droid-adapter): "Configure Pooler for Factory Droid language-model routes on port 18474."
- [Configure Multi-Provider Gateway](docs/agent-native.md#configure-universal-multi-provider-gateway): "Configure Pooler universal gateway on port 8400 supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini SDKs."
- [Migrate from CLIProxyAPI](docs/agent-native.md#migrate-legacy-cliproxyapi-configuration): "Perform dry-run migration of legacy CLIProxyAPI YAML to validated Pooler configuration."
- [Run System Diagnostics](docs/agent-native.md#run-system-diagnostics--health-checks): "Run pooler doctor and pooler preflight to inspect DNS, TLS, listener ports, and credentials."
